Subject: Handoff: IonWave pilot — owners, timeline, integration risks

Hi Jamie / Lena —

Thanks again for a great demo last week. IonWave is greenlit for a 6-week pilot (3-week ingest + 3-week evaluation) per the terms we outlined. I wanted to loop in the Customer Success and Implementation leads so we can lock owners, finalize the kickoff, and surface any early blockers.

Summary / ask:
- Pilot objective: validate Redwood API integration for clinical summarization and embedding search across ~250k documents. Success metric: end-to-end latency < 600ms median and avg embedding recall > 0.85 on our seed prompts.
- Kickoff target: Wed Apr 14 (TZ: PST) — initial sync + environment handoff.
- Key technical notes: IonWave will host data in AWS us-west-2, SSO via Okta (SAML), and requires data retention policy: 90 days transient KV cache, logs retained 180 days.
- Security/compliance: they completed our questionnaire; SOC2 attestation is required by their procurement team and we agreed to provide audit logs during pilot.

Attachments: IonWave-SOW-v1.pdf (SOW draft), ionwave-data-flow.png (high level infra), pilot-implementation-runbook.md (initial checklist). DocuSign link below for signatures.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal owners assigned by EOD today.
2) Confirm kickoff time on Apr 14.
3) CS to review SSO and audit-log requirements and flag any blockers.

Marissa / Tessa / Ben — can you take owner assignment and call out any immediate risks? Jamie / Lena — if those dates are tight, let us know your availability.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez

Adding a few technical checks I want to surface prior to kickoff:
- Networking: IonWave's S3 buckets must allow the Redwood ingest role (we provided the role ARN in the onboarding doc). Please ensure CORS on the bucket is configured for our ingestion runner.
- Rate limits & quotas: For the pilot we'll set a conservative burst cap to avoid token throttles; we'll lift caps once sample traffic is validated.
- Model choices: We'll start the pilot on the 'redwood-llama-13b-quant' variant to balance cost & latency; if latency is high on long documents we'll switch to the non-quantized 13B for evaluation.

I attached a short runbook snippet (pilot-implementation-runbook.md) that outlines the first 5 days and the SSO checklist. I'll lead validation of the embedding pipeline during week 1 and stay on the onboarding calls.

—Ben
